fundamental.summary: ETR shows no fundamental momentum: zero insider activity, no institutional signal, no government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and earnings in 70 days present elevated risk.

sentiment.summary: Extreme fear (10/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but absent recent congressional activity and news data limit conviction; neutral AAII sentiment suggests mixed positioning.

risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis regime (378.4) combined with flat yield curve and negative macro score (-3) creates severely unfavourable conditions; earnings in 70 days adds moderate event risk but is not imminent.

debate.key_bull_argument: Strong technical trend structure (price above 200-EMA, supertrend bullish, Ichimoku above cloud, MACD crossover) with extreme fear sentiment (10/100) creating contrarian buy opportunity near support.
debate.key_bear_argument: Macro environment in crisis (VIX 378.4, negative macro score -3, flat yield curve), zero fundamental support (no insider activity, weak smart money, earnings risk in 70 days), overbought stochastics, missing momentum confirmations (OBV, AO false), and low volume ratio (0.69) severely outweigh technical bullishness.
